import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import xgboost as xgb
from xgboost import EarlyStopping
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Paths
train_path = "./input/train.csv"
test_path = "./input/test.csv"
sample_sub_path = "./input/sample_submission.csv"
sub_dir = "./submission/"

# Load datasets
train_df = pd.read_csv(train_path)
test_df = pd.read_csv(test_path)
sample_sub = pd.read_csv(sample_sub_path)

# Preprocessing: drop id, target, and high-cardinality string feature f_27
drop_cols = ["id", "target", "f_27"]
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in drop_cols]

X = train_df[feature_cols]
y = train_df["target"]

# Strict stratified hold-out split for validation
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X, y, test_size=0.2, stratify=y, random_state=42
)

# Initialize XGBoost classifier
params = {
    "objective": "binary:logistic",
    "eval_metric": "auc",
    "max_depth": 6,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "n_estimators": 500,
    "random_state": 42,
    "verbosity": 0,
    "tree_method": "hist",
}

model = xgb.XGBClassifier(**params)

# Train with early stopping via callbacks (fixes the TypeError)
callbacks = [EarlyStopping(rounds=50, save_best_only=True)]
model.fit(
    X_train, y_train, eval_set=[(X_val, y_val)], callbacks=callbacks, verbose=False
)

# Evaluate on genuine hold-out validation set
val_probs = model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_probs)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.6f}")

# Retrain fresh model on full training distribution for final predictions
final_model = xgb.XGBClassifier(**params)
final_model.fit(X, y, verbose=False)

# Generate probability predictions for the unlabeled test set
test_preds = final_model.predict_proba(test_df[feature_cols])[:, 1]

# Assemble and save submission file using sample template
submission = sample_sub.copy()
submission["target"] = test_preds
submission.to_csv(f"{sub_dir}/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved successfully to ./submission/submission.csv")
